Velocity , acceleration .

  • Direction: moving right (positive direction) when , left when , at rest when .

Questions 55–57, 65Section 3.9

Related rates

MethodSection 3.9
  1. Name the quantities that change, and write down which rate is given and which is asked for. “Decreasing” means a negative rate.
  2. Write an equation relating the quantities (geometry: area, volume, Pythagoras, similar triangles, trig).
  3. Differentiate both sides with respect to .
  4. Only now plug in the numbers for the given instant, and solve for the unknown rate. Give units.
